safety_description: This issue needs attention within the next 1-2 weeks. Your vehicle is safe for short trips, but the problem will get worse or more expensive if ignored.
dont_panic: Your 2021 Jeep WRANGLER UNLIMITED is showing code P0420. This means the catalytic converter (a part that reduces harmful emissions) is not working efficiently. The vehicle’s own measurements show the converter is well past its manufacturer limit (0.9 vs. 0.5), meaning it is genuinely worn out. This is not a temporary issue—it requires repair. No other measurements were available to check for other problems.
likely_causes: 1. The catalytic converter is worn out. The vehicle’s own data (mode06[21]) shows it measured 0.9 against a manufacturer limit of 0.5, proving it is past its usable lifespan.
symptoms:
1. Reduced engine power or hesitation during acceleration — the converter’s failure affects how the engine breathes.
2. A sulfur or burning smell from the exhaust — worn converters can emit odors.
3. The check engine light staying on — the code P0420 triggers this.
4. Increased fuel consumption — inefficient emissions control can lower fuel economy.
if_ignored: In the next few weeks, the converter could fail completely, causing expensive repairs and potential damage to other engine parts. Long-term, the vehicle may fail emissions tests or develop more severe engine issues. Repair costs will rise if other components are damaged. Driving with a faulty converter also increases emissions, which harms the environment.
quick_checks: - Get a replacement quote; confirm no upstream fault remains
diy_fix: This repair is NOT recommended for DIY because it requires special tools, lifting the vehicle, and precise installation. A professional mechanic should handle this.
urgency: Try to get this looked at in the next few days. Driving short trips is fine, but do not delay repairs.
